# Project Lotus : Code Of Conduct

---

This document applies to all of usage/interaction of the following places:
- GitHub (Whether contributing, commenting in an issue/pull request, etc)
- Discord Server (Talking to others members, hosting lobbies, making suggestions/reports, etc.)
- Within the Project: Lotus Mod itself.

We are for the community, and that means we will not tolerate harassment of any kind.

---
## What we expect from you:
- Be respectful of others at all times.
- Do not abuse bugs of any kind, minor or major.
- Use common sense when playing or interacting with others, whether that be in-game or on other platforms.
- Enjoy the game and make the game enjoyable for others, especially for newer players who may not be familiar with the mod.

###  Avoid the following:
- Harassment of any kind, this extends to discrimination, doxxing, or any other form of harassment.
- Cheating, in any form. This includes using using external mods to cheat, or abusing debug features of the mod.
- Ruining the fun of other players, including targetting them, etc.

Remember that you must also follow the Terms of Service or Community Guidelines of either Among Us, GitHub, or Discord. (Depending on the platform)

---
## Reporting:
If you have any concerns or issues, please contact us via Discord, or email.

We do our best to respond to all reports, so if you do not get an immediate response, please be patient.

Please also include information relating to the offender, this includes at lease one of the following:
- Discord ID (ex: 123456789012345678)
- Among Us Friend Code (ex: thinkfish#4122)
- Among Us Hashed PUID

The following must also be included:
- Screenshots of the offender's actions.
- Client Logs (found in the `Among Us/Logs` folder)

**Please note that in-game offenses should also be reported to Innersloth using the in-game report system.**

### Contact Information:
[Discord Server](https://discord.gg/projectlotus) | <a href="mailto:project@lotusau.top?subject=Reporting a Player">project@lotusau.top</a>

---
We appreciate you for helping us keep Lotus safe for all users, thank you. --- lotus forever 🪷
